text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Pengangkutan Jalan

(Larangan Penggunaan Jalan) (Jalan Persekutuan) (No. 13) 2023.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 16 Jun 2023.

Larangan

2. Pemanduan dan penggunaan kenderaan barangan di atas bahagian jalan yang

dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama sebagaimana yang ditunjukkan dalam peta

dalam Jadual Kedua, pada hari dan masa yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (2)

Jadual Pertama, dilarang.

Pengecualian

3. Pengecualian daripada larangan itu hendaklah diberikan bagi maksud dan dalam

hal keadaan yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual Ketiga.

JADUAL PERTAMA

(1)

Jalan yang baginya Larangan Terpakai

(2)

Hari dan Masa Larangan

Laluan 59, Jalan Tapah–Cameron

Highlands dari koordinat U 4.518469,

T 101.427908 hingga U 4.425714,

T 101.386706

Jumaat hingga Ahad

10.00 pagi hingga 3.00 petang

JADUAL KEDUA

JADUAL KETIGA

PENGECUALIAN

1. Bagi maksud penyelenggaraan, pembaikan, peningkatan, pembersihan dan

pemugaran bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama.

2. Bagi maksud pemacakan, pemasangan, penyelenggaraan, pengubahan

atau pengalihan mana-mana struktur, kerja, peralatan atau apa-apa benda

di dalam, di bawah atau di atas bahagian jalan yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1)

Jadual Pertama.

3. Bagi maksud perkhidmatan kecemasan dan penguatkuasaan oleh agensi Kerajaan

dan pihak berkuasa tempatan.

4. Bagi maksud pemeriksaan, pembuangan dan penghantaran sisa domestik oleh

kenderaan berat seperti lori sampah, lori pembersihan pembentungan dan lori

vakum pembentungan.

5. Bagi maksud kecemasan, penggunaan mana-mana jalan lain selain yang terdapat

dalam koordinat yang dinyatakan dalam ruang (1) Jadual Pertama menjadi

mustahil atau tidak sesuai.

Dibuat 14 Jun 2023

[KKR.100-1/2/79 Jld.5; PN(PU2)460/Jld. 125]

DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

 Menteri Kerja Raya

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD)

(FEDERAL ROADS) (NO. 13) ORDER 2023

WHEREAS by P.U. (B) 23/2023 published on 20 January 2023, notice was given

of the intention to make an order under section 70 of the Road Transport Act 1987

[Act 333]:

AND WHEREAS objection was received by the Minister of Works against

the making of such order:

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 70 of the Act,

the Minister of Works, after taking into consideration to the objection and the matters

referred to in subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Road Transport

(Prohibition of Use of Road) (Federal Roads) (No. 13) Order 2023.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 16 June 2023.

Prohibition

2. The driving or use of good vehicles on the part of the road as specified in

column (1) of the First Schedule as shown on the map in the Second Schedule,

on the day and time specified in column (2) of the First Schedule, is prohibited.

Exemption

3. Exemption from such prohibition shall be given for the purposes and

in circumstances specified in Third Schedule.

FIRST SCHEDULE

(1)

Road to which Prohibition Applies

(2)

Day and Time of Prohibition

Route 59, Tapah–Cameron Highlands

Road from coordinate N 4.518469,

E 101.427908 until N 4.425714,

E 101.386706

 Friday to Sunday

10.00 a.m to 3.00 p.m

SECOND SCHEDULE

THIRD SCHEDULE

EXEMPTION

1. For the purposes of maintenance, repair, improvement, cleaning and clearance of

the part of road specified in column (1) of the First Schedule.

2. For the purposes of erection, installation, maintenance, alteration or removal of

any structure, works, apparatus or anything in, under or over the part of the road

specified in column (1) of the First Schedule.

3. For the purposes of emergency services and enforcement by the

Government agencies and local authorities.

4. For the purposes of checking, disposal and delivery of domestic waste by

heavy vehicle such as garbage truck, sewerage cleaning truck and sewerage

vacuum truck.

5. For the purposes of emergency, the use of any other road other than which

appears in the coordinate specified in column (1) of the First Schedule is

rendered impossible or unsuitable.

Made 14 June 2023

[KKR.100-1/2/79 Jld.5; PN(PU2)460/Jld. 125]

 DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

 Minister of Works
